state_code: # SOURCES (North Dakota Mathematics Content Standards K-12, July 2023, REV2 2024-06-27; implemented 2024-25; DPI page checked 2026-10-01)
# - There is no official ND-to-CCSS crosswalk. ND 2017 codes (K.CC.1 etc.) follow CCSS numbering, so the 2017 crosswalk was used as a guide;
#   final ccss mappings are my own reading of the 2023 text against CCSS.
# - NO = Number and Operations: CC Counting and Cardinality, NBT Base Ten, NF Fractions
# - AR = Algebraic Reasoning: OA Operations and Algebraic Thinking
# - GM = Geometry and Measurement: G Geometry, M Measurement
# - DPS = Data, Probability, and Statistics: D Data
# - Math Attributes (K-2.MA.P/C/R, 3-5.MA.*) are process standards and are skipped. Clarification column text was read but not coded.
# CCSS K-5 STANDARDS DROPPED OR NOT FOUND
# - K.G.A.1 (positions such as above/below/next to): no 2023 K standard.
# - K.G.B.5 (model shapes by building/drawing): not in the 2017-2023 crosswalk; no 2023 match.
# - 1.OA.B.3 (properties to add/subtract): no grade 1 standard (properties start at 2.AR.OA.2). 1.OA.C.5: crosswalk calls it a strategy only.
# - 2.MD.B.5 (length word problems): not in the crosswalk; no 2023 match.
# - 2.G.A.2 (rows and columns of squares): crosswalk says it is embedded in 2.NO.NF.3, but that text only says more parts are smaller; treated as dropped.
# - 1.OA.D.8 (unknown in an equation): only "unknowns" inside story problems (1.AR.OA.4/5); not stated on its own.
# - 2.NBT.B.7 (add/subtract within 1,000): moved to grade 3 (3.NO.NBT.3). Crosswalk says so.
# - 5.NF.B.3 (fraction as division): no 2023 grade 5 standard and not in the crosswalk.
# - 5.NF.B.7 (divide unit fractions/whole numbers): moved to 6.NO.O.3 per the crosswalk.
# - 5.MD.C.5 (volume formulas, additive volume): moved to 6.GM.AV.2 per the crosswalk.
# - 5.NBT.B.7: decimal division moved to grade 6. 3.MD.D.8: perimeter of rectangles only.
# - K.G.A.2/K.G.A.3: K solids are cubes and spheres only (cones, cylinders in grade 1).
# - 3.OA.C.7: automaticity expected only for facts to 5 x 5 and tens (10 x 10 in grade 4, 12 x 12 in grade 5).
# - New: counting backward K-2 (K.NO.CC.2, 1.NO.CC.2, 2.NO.CC.2), subitizing (K.NO.CC.4, 1.NO.CC.4), repeating/growing patterns (K.AR.OA.6, 1.AR.OA.7),
#   daily time words (K.GM.M.2), faces of solids (2.GM.G.2), fraction-decimal equivalents (5.NO.NF.1), facts to 12 x 12 (5.AR.OA.1).
# - Moved earlier: coins and dollar in grade 1, skip counting by 5s/10s in grade 1, make-20 and decompose-20 in grade 1,
#   numbers to 10,000 in grade 3, lines/angles/parallel/perpendicular and symmetry in grade 3, money word problems in grade 3.
# - Moved later or repeated: factors/primes extended to 1-100 in grade 5 (5.AR.OA.4; grade 4 limits to 1-36).
# - 1.AR.OA.2 (make 20) and 1.AR.OA.3 (decompose to 20) are extensions of K.OA.A.4 / K.OA.A.3 to 20; marked moved, could be read as new.
# - 1.GM.G.1/1.GM.G.2 name more shapes than CCSS lists; mapped to 1.G.A.1 as edited.
# - 4.AR.OA.2 (properties of all four operations) mapped to 1.OA.B.3 and 3.OA.B.5 as moved; CCSS grade 4 uses properties only inside 4.NBT.B.5/6.
# - 4.DPS.D.1 (collect data, choose a graph) mapped to 3.MD.B.3 as moved; 4.DPS.D.3 and 5.DPS.D.2 (solve problems from graphs) as edited.
# - 5.GM.M.2 adds perimeter to fraction-side rectangle area (5.NF.B.4b in CCSS).
# - K.NO.CC.1 second sentence (count forward from any number within 100) is in the standard cell in the PDF table, so K.CC.A.2 is included.
# - kind is judged on content: same = CCSS content with only rewording or small example changes.
